title: Homemade Coca-Cola
description: A homemade version of Coca-Cola made from scratch with natural ingredients, without phosphoric acids and corn syrups.

ingredients.item: cinnamon stick or three small cinnamon sticks
Sparkling water (e.g., Spin Drift with real lemon juice)

steps: Heat a pot on medium-low heat.
Add coconut sugar and stir until it becomes sticky.
Add water and bring to a simmer.
Add cinnamon sticks, lemon peel, lime peel, and orange peel.
Add a dash of coriander and a pinch of nutmeg.
Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes until the mixture thickens and flavors meld.
Strain the syrup into a glass jar to remove peels and spices.
Add vanilla extract and bitters to the syrup and let it cool for 30 minutes.
In a glass, combine 1 part syrup with 3 parts sparkling water.
Stir gently and serve over ice.
notes:
Adjust the amount of sparkling water to taste for a less or more carbonated drink.
